content.text: Queueing all nine drafts for approval. I've put the quotes in the reasons, and flagged that the records chase for the unhappy client should wait until after the apology.

input.subject: Getting you ready for the 7 November deadline
input.body:
Hi [FIRST_1],

Thanks for getting in touch, and please don't panic – this can be sorted. As you're over £50k you've been in Making Tax Digital since April, so your first update is still outstanding and the second is due on 07/11/2026. The first job is to see what records you have and get both quarters in order.

I can take you on this week. Could we have a free 15-minute call tomorrow or Friday to go through what you've got and what I'd need from you?

Kind regards,
Mutalib

input.subject: I'm sorry about the repeated requests
input.body:
Hi [FIRST_14],

Thank you for being honest with me. You're right: being asked for the same statement three times is frustrating, and I'm sorry we put you through that.

Here's what I'll do. I'll check everything you've already sent before we ask for anything else, and give you one single, short list of what's really missing. I'll also be your one point of contact, so you don't hear from different people.

Could we have a quick call this week to go through it together? Whenever suits you.

Kind regards,
Mutalib

input.subject: Your records for the 07/11/2026 update
input.body:
Hi [FIRST_14],

I hope you're well. We're getting close to the quarterly update due on 07/11/2026, and I'm still missing some records for 6 July to 5 October. I know you've sent us a lot already, so if any of these are with us, just tell me which and I'll find them.

What I need:
• Bank statements for 6 July – 5 October
• Rent invoices or statements from your agent
• Receipts for expenses over £25
• Your mileage log, if you have one

If anything is hard to find, tell me and we'll work it out together.

Thanks,
Mutalib
